cases.translation: The Lord will punish Leviathan with his sword.
cases.explain: Господь is the subject of the verb покарает (will punish), so it takes nominative case.

cases.sentence: ___ и ночь его охраняю, чтобы никто его не повредил.
cases.translation: Day and night I guard it.
cases.explain: День is the direct object governed by the preposition (implied time period), taking accusative case.

cases.sentence: В тот ___ поете о плодородном винограднике.
cases.translation: In that day, sing about the fruitful vineyard.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) governing a temporal noun requires the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: ___ Израиль расцветет, и наполнит весь мир плодами.
cases.translation: Israel will blossom and fill the world with fruit.
cases.explain: Израиль as the subject of расцветет (will blossom) uses nominative case.

cases.sentence: Я бы войною на них пошел, предал бы их ___.
cases.translation: I would give them to fire.
cases.explain: The dative case is used with verbs expressing giving or direction toward a goal.

cases.sentence: Как в ___ , когда дует свирепый восточный ветер.
cases.translation: As in the day when the fierce east wind blows.
cases.explain: Temporal nouns with the preposition (like) use the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: В грядущие дни пустит корни Иаков, даст побег и расцветет ___ , и наполнит весь мир плодами.
cases.translation: Israel will blossom and fill the world with fruit.
cases.explain: Израиль as the subject of расцветет (will blossom) uses nominative case.

cases.sentence: Разве так поражал их Господь, как поразил Он тех, кто их поражал? В тот ___ Господь сил будет славным венцом.
cases.translation: In that day, the Lord of Hosts will be a glorious crown.
cases.explain: The genitive case often follows temporal prepositions or is used in partitive constructions.

reading.ru: В тот день Господь сил будет славным венцом, прекрасным венком для уцелевших из его народа.
reading.question: What will the Lord of Hosts become on that day?
reading.explain: The text states that the Lord will become a glorious crown for the survivors of his people.

reading.ru: Я не гневаюсь. Если бы встали против меня терновник с колючками, я бы войною на них пошел, предал бы их огню.
reading.question: What would God do if thorns and briers rose against him?
reading.explain: God says he would go to war with them and give them over to fire.

reading.ru: В грядущие дни пустит корни Иаков, даст побег и расцветет Израиль, и наполнит весь мир плодами.
reading.question: What will happen to Israel in coming days?
options: Israel will blossom and fill the world with fruit
Israel will wander in the desert
reading.correct: Israel will blossom and fill the world with fruit
reading.explain: The passage describes Israel taking root, sprouting, blossoming, and filling the world with fruit.

reading.ru: Разве так поражал их Господь, как поразил Он тех, кто их поражал?
reading.question: Is God striking Israel in the same way He struck their enemies?
options: Yes, He treats them the same
reading.explain: The rhetorical question suggests that God does not strike Israel in the same way as their enemies.

reading.ru: И вот чем снимется вина Иакова, вот что будет плодом прощения его греха.
reading.question: What will be the result of Jacob's sin being forgiven?
options: The altar stones will be broken to powder
reading.correct: The altar stones will be broken to powder
reading.explain: The passage connects the forgiveness of sin to the removal of idolatrous altars and images.

reading.ru: Опустел укрепленный город, брошено селение, оставлено, как пустыня.
reading.question: What will happen to the fortified city?
options: It will be abandoned like a wilderness
reading.correct: It will be abandoned like a wilderness
reading.explain: The text states that the fortified city will be forsaken and become like a wilderness.
